item.title: Password Cracking Course
item.author: bradinrohde0@gmail.com (Bradin Rohde)
item.description:
root@brohde:~# cat PasswordCracking.txt

Welcome to one of my favorite subjects! Here we'll cover password cracking techniques from hash to cracked! More courses to come!

root@brohde:~# cat Syllabus.md

# Beginner Courses
### PC1010 - Intro to Password Cracking
An introductory lesson for password cracking. Covers the idea behind using hashes, how they are cracked, and various types of offline password attacks.

### PC1510 - Intro to Hashcat
An introductory lesson to Hashcat. This lesson will cover the usage of the dictionary, combinator, brute force, and hybrid attack modes.

### PC1520 - Intro to JohnTheRipper
An introductory lesson to JohnTheRipper. This lesson covers the wordlist, single crack, mask, and incremental attack modes.

### PC1530 – Intro to OphCrack
An introductory lesson to OphCrack. This lesson covers the basics of rainbow tables and their usage in cracking passwords.

# Beginner Labs
### PC1515 - Hashcat Lab
Using Hashcat to crack 3 different sets of hashes

### PC1525 – JtR Lab
Using John the Ripper to crack 3 different sets of hashes
